gaps.hint: to his credit = in his favour
gaps.explanation: 'to somebody's credit' — something in their favour.

gaps.sentence: He denied everything ___ the face of the evidence.
gaps.hint: ___ the face of = when confronted with
gaps.explanation: 'in the face of' = despite / when confronted by.

gaps.sentence: ___ contrast to her sister, she loves publicity.
The project is ___ way to completion ahead of schedule.
The museum is open to the public ___ appointment only.
He did it ___ purpose, just to annoy her.
___ terms of quality, the cheaper model wins.
I did it ___ my own initiative — nobody asked me.
gaps.explanation: 'of one's own initiative' = without being asked.
